item.title: Commuting & Transportation in Anne Arundel County
item.description:
Commuting & Transportation in Anne Arundel County

As someone who has commuted from Anne Arundel County to both Baltimore and DC for over a decade, every transportation option has been tried. This guide shares what works, what doesn’t, and how to choose the right commute for your life.

Understanding Your Commute Options

Major Highways

Primary Routes Through Anne Arundel County:

MD-2 (Ritchie Highway)

  • Route: Annapolis to Baltimore
  • Usage: Heavy commuter traffic, especially mornings (6-9 AM) and evenings (4-7 PM)
  • Key Intersections: I-95, MD-174, US-50
  • Traffic Patterns:
    • Morning rush: 6:00-9:30 AM
    • Evening rush: 3:30-7:00 PM
    • Avoid if possible during peak hours

MD-3 (Annapolis Boulevard)

item.title: Commuting & Transportation in Anne Arundel County
item.description:
Commuting & Transportation in Anne Arundel County

Estimated reading time: 5 minutes

Living in Anne Arundel County means you’re between Baltimore and Washington DC, which is both a blessing and a curse for transportation. You’ve got options, but choosing the right ones depends entirely on where you work and how you want to spend your time.

Driving: The Default Option

Let’s be honest - most people drive here. The county was built around cars, and even though public transit exists, driving is still the primary mode of transportation for the vast majority of residents.

item.title: BWI Airport Guide - Getting There & Using the Rail Station
item.description:
BWI Airport Guide

Baltimore-Washington International Thurgood Marshall Airport sits right in Anne Arundel County, which makes it your local airport. That convenience means you’re usually 10-20 minutes from terminals depending on where you live in the county.

Location & Access

Address: 700 Ground Circle, Baltimore, MD 21240

BWI sits between Annapolis and Glen Burnie, south of MD-3 and east of I-95. The airport owns the land, so while the mailing address says Baltimore, you’re physically in Anne Arundel.

item.title: Anne Arundel County Transit Routes
item.description:
Anne Arundel County Transit Routes

Public transit in Anne Arundel County centers on the MTA bus system and MARC train. Routes connect the county to Baltimore and DC, plus local circulation within communities.

MTA Commuter Bus Routes

The Maryland Transit Administration runs commuter buses from Anne Arundel to Baltimore and Washington DC. These are your main options for car-free commuting.
